control.description-key: Clickable map of Portugal (districts, Azores, Madeira) with hover highlight and location pins.

property.name: selectedIds
property.description-key: Selected IDs separated by |, for example PT-11|L03. Set it to preselect; read it to get the selection.

property.name: placesJson
property.description-key: JSON array of pins with ID, Name, Latitude and Longitude, for example JSON(ShowColumns(Locais, ID, Name, Latitude, Longitude)).

property.name: selectRegions
property.description-key: true lets users select districts; false makes only pins selectable.

property.name: multiSelect
property.description-key: true allows several selections; false keeps only the last one.

property.name: showLabels
property.description-key: Shows district names on the map.

property.name: accentColor
property.description-key: Hex colour for selected and hovered shapes, for example #FF5F00.

property.name: hoveredId
property.description-key: ID of the district or pin under the mouse (blank when none).

property.name: hoveredName
property.description-key: Name of the district or pin under the mouse (blank when none).

property.name: selectedNames
property.description-key: Names of the selected districts and pins, separated by commas.

property.name: selectedCount
property.description-key: Number of selected districts and pins.
